method: DOM getBoundingClientRect() x deviceScaleFactor(2) => screenshot pixels. Canvas-drawn blocks are not DOM; their boxes are document geometry x zoom offset from the Email frame origin on the canvas (calibrated from a drawn frame). Preview blocks are DOM rects inside the preview iframe. All boxes are {x,y,w,h} in the PNG pixel space of that shot.
emailConcept: Hollowpine Coffee Roasters (fictional): launch of Ember Ridge winter blend

notes.preview: "preview" holds raw element rects (may extend outside the iframe viewport); "previewVisible" holds the part clipped to the iframe, null when scrolled out of view.
notes.layersPanel: In 04-layers-panel.png the bottom row (Header logo) is partly under the Selection sets bar.
notes.imageServer: Asset base URL http://127.0.0.1:5301 (/tmp/store/cdn2.py) serves the generated PNGs from /workspace/store-assets by node id.
